definitions.explanation: Stopping an activity or event that was planned or in progress.

examples.japanese: {雨|あめ}で{試合|しあい}が{中止|ちゅうし}になった。
examples.english: The game was canceled due to rain.

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}を{中止|ちゅうし}する。
{イベントは|いべんとは}{台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{中止|ちゅうし}となりました。
examples.english: The event has been canceled due to the typhoon.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
・{中止|ちゅうし}: Cancellation, stopping something (often permanent or indefinite)
・{中断|ちゅうだん}: Interruption, temporary suspension (implies resumption later)
・{延期|えんき}: Postponement (rescheduled for later)
・{取|と}り{消|け}し: Cancellation, withdrawal (often for reservations, orders)

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜が{中止|ちゅうし}になる (~ is/gets canceled)
・〜を{中止|ちゅうし}する (to cancel ~)
・{中止|ちゅうし}の{お知|しら}らせ (cancellation notice)
